reactions.description: TrpM catalyzes N-methylation of L-tryptophan to produce L-abrine (N-alpha-methyl-L-tryptophan)

TrpM methyltransferase catalyzes iterative N-methylations to produce L-abrine (N-alpha-methyl-L-tryptophan), N,N-alpha-dimethyl-L-tryptophan and L-hypaphorine (N,N,N-alpha-trimethyl-L-tryptophan). TrpM can also N-methylate the non-native amino acid substrate, 4-hydroxytryptophan.
TrpM catalyzes N-methylation of L-abrine (N-alpha-methyl-L-tryptophan) to form N,N-alpha-dimethyl-L-tryptophan
TrpM catalyzes N-methylation of N,N-alpha-dimethyl-L-tryptophan to yield L-hypaphorine (N,N,N-alpha-trimethyl-L-tryptophan)
